title: BatchEnsemble rank-one Mirror ensemble
hypothesis: Shared hidden map with learned Givens member coordinates yields higher ensemble diversity/quality per actual byte than native BatchEnsemble rank-one member factors while approaching independent ensemble quality.
physical_object: shared 16x16 feature map and 16x4 output head
mirror_coordinate: four learned hidden-space Givens member views

task.metric: ensemble NLL, accuracy, ECE, pairwise disagreement

controls: one shared predictor replicated as four members
shared hidden map plus Givens Mirror members

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus metadata
paid_objects: all member or shared learned weights

success_gate: Mirror ensemble NLL <=1.10x independent; ECE <= independent + 0.03; bytes <=60% independent; and beats BatchEnsemble by >=10% NLL or >=20% disagreement at byte-near cost.
failure_gate: Mirror quality/storage gate missed or BatchEnsemble matches at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: no capacity proof from fixed updates

amendments.reason: Initial development classifier was not learnable within the fixed update budget: independent control remained near chance with high NLL on both development worlds.
amendments.change: Development teacher changed to four well-separated Gaussian class prototypes with label determined by nearest prototype; retain the same model methods, update budget, rates, dev seeds, selection rule, gates and sealed fresh worlds.
amendments.scope: Task generator only; all candidate comparisons rerun from scratch on the amended dev protocol.

amendments.reason: Code audit found training and evaluation data seeds depended on method-specific initialization seed, invalidating cross-method comparisons.
amendments.change: All methods at a given development world now use identical train/dev examples; model initialization seeds remain separate and deterministic. Rerun every method/LR/world from scratch.
amendments.scope: Seed plumbing correction only; teacher, methods, updates, LR grid, selection metric, gates, and sealed fresh worlds unchanged.
